Datapages

This module assists in creating datapages, and provides additional panels for this purpose. It is greatly recommended to see the datapage examples alongside this section.

AstroToolkit.Datapages.buttons(source/pos, *)[source]

Generates Vizier and SIMBAD search buttons for a given target.

Parameters:

  • source (int) – Target GAIA DR3 Source ID

  • pos (list<float>) – Position [right ascension, declination] in degrees

  • radius (int, optional) – search radius in arcseconds, default = config

  • grid_size (int, optional) – datapage grid size used for scaling, default = config

Returns:

Vizier and SIMBAD search buttons

Return type:

bokeh figure


AstroToolkit.Datapages.datatable(selection, source/pos, *)[source]

Generates a datatable for a given target.

Parameters:

  • source (int) – Target GAIA DR3 Source ID

  • pos (list<float>) – Position [right ascension, declination] in degrees

  • radius (int, optional) – search radius to use when fetching data from supported surveys in arcseconds, default = config

  • selection (dict<str> or dict<dict>) – dict of datatable entries, with each entry taking a different format depending on the use case:

To generate entires for supported surveys quickly and easily:

survey: "default"

where:

Parameters:

survey (str) –

supported survey, from:

  • gaia

  • panstarrs

  • skymapper

  • galex

  • sdss

  • wise

  • twomass (2MASS)

  • rosat


For customised entries within supported surveys:

survey: {
        "parameters": parameters
        "errors": errors
        "notes": notes
        }

where:

Parameters:

  • survey (str) –

    supported survey, from:

    • gaia

    • panstarrs

    • skymapper

    • galex

    • rosat

    • sdss

    • wise

    • twomass (2MASS)

    • erosita

  • parameters (list<str>) – names of parameters (i.e. column headers) that exist in chosen survey

  • errors (list<str>) – names of errors on these parameters (i.e. column headers) that exist in chosen survey

  • notes (list<str>) – any notes to include on each of the chosen parameters/errors


For customised entries outside of supported surveys:

survey: {
        "parameters": parameters
        "values": values
        "errors": errors
        "notes": notes
        }

where:

Parameters:

  • survey (str) – name of survey to which the data belongs

  • parameters (list<str>) – names of parameters

  • values (list<float>) – values of these parameters

  • errors (list<float>) – error values on these parameters

  • notes (list<str>) – any notes to include on each of the chosen parameters/errors

Returns:

populated datatable

Return type:

bokeh figure


AstroToolkit.Datapages.gridsetup(dimensions, plots, *)[source]

Assists in setting up panels for use in datapages.

Parameters:

dimensions (dict<int>) – dimensions of plot in grid units, in format:

'width': width
'height': height
Parameters:

plots (list<dict>) – plots for use in datapage, with each entry in format:

'name': name
'figure': figure
'width': width
'height': height

where:

Parameters:

  • name (str) – name to assign to the figure

  • figure (class or bokeh figure or None) – The figure to give this panel, this can either be an ATK structure that supports plotting (lightcurve, image, etc.) or a Bokeh figure. If filling empty space, None can instead be passed to create a blank panel.

  • width (int) – width of panel in grid units

  • height (int) – height of panel in grid units

Returns:

dictionary of plots with keys = names assigned to each panel

Return type:

dict
